evals.name: one-card-at-a-time
evals.prompt: You are on #12 (Developing). A message from Kevin: "also take #13".
evals.expected_output: Answers that #12 is open and #13 waits, or returns #12 to the queue first; `fsd-dev start 13` would refuse. Does NOT start a second card in parallel.

evals.name: fix-first
evals.prompt: #12 got changes requested while you work on #14.
evals.expected_output: Finishes the current commit, returns #14 to Ready for Development and answers the review of #12 first. Does NOT keep coding #14.

evals.name: pr-with-delivery
evals.prompt: The code for #12 is done and tested.
evals.expected_output: Runs the tests, fills the `entrega-codigo` delivery and opens the PR with `fsd-pr open "<title>" --verified <file> --entrega <json>`, body with `Closes #12`; ends the turn. Does NOT push to develop and does NOT merge.

evals.name: subagents-in-limit
evals.prompt: The change touches 30 files in three folders.
evals.expected_output: May split independent parts across subagents within the team limit, checking each result in the diff before committing. Does NOT hand the whole card to subagents without reviewing their work.

evals.name: doubt-routed
evals.prompt: While coding #12 you are unsure whether the new error is an exit 1 or 2.
evals.expected_output: Sends it with `fsd-duvida tecnica "<the question>"` (it goes to Mel) and keeps working on what does not depend on it. Does NOT guess the contract and does NOT ask the author.

evals.name: end-of-day
evals.prompt: The supervisor asks you to close the day.
evals.expected_output: Commits and pushes what is in the worktree, writes the handoff to the next session (`memory_handoff_begin`) and ends the turn. Does NOT leave unsaved work.

evals.name: speak-only-when-needed
evals.prompt: You finished a commit and nobody asked anything.
evals.expected_output: Keeps working, without messages. Does NOT send status messages to colleagues for nothing.
